# Indoor Wayfinding Solution

> Indoor wayfinding, indoor navigation, indoor positioning, indoor mapping and spatial operations for shopping malls, airports, hospitals, campuses, museums and exhibition centres. Modules include 3D indoor maps, turn-by-turn navigation, AR wayfinding, interactive and digital directories, parking guidance with reverse car finding, people counting, indoor geofencing, staff positioning and patrol.

Everything here is delivered as a platform plus deployment service: map production, positioning design (BLE, UWB, Wi-Fi or hybrid), kiosk and signage specification, integration with venue systems, calibration, acceptance testing and ongoing support. Delivery models are SaaS, private cloud and on-premise. We do not sell consumer navigation apps, outdoor maps, robot navigation, asset tracking or RTLS hardware, and we do not provide camera-based identity tracking.

## Core pages

- /: indoor wayfinding solution, the module map and the live demo
- /indoor-navigation-system/: turn-by-turn indoor navigation across floors, step-free routing, outdoor-to-indoor handover
- /indoor-positioning-system/: BLE, UWB, Wi-Fi and hybrid positioning, accuracy, floor detection, calibration
- /indoor-mapping/: 3D and multi-floor indoor maps, walk graph, map editor, data ownership
- /indoor-wayfinding-software/: platform, REST API and SDK, deployment models, integrations, SLA
- /mall-wayfinding/: mall directory, tenant and event promotion, parking, measured effect
- /ar-indoor-navigation/: camera-overlay AR guidance and when it beats a 2D map
- /parking-guidance-system/: bay guidance, reverse car finder, bay reservation
- /indoor-wayfinding-price/: what drives cost, three delivery scopes, how a budget is built
- /people-counting-system/: footfall, zone heatmaps, journey paths, privacy profile
- /geofence/: indoor and venue geofencing, zone rules, alerts
- /staff-positioning/: dispatch, patrol and emergency response with consent and retention limits
- /patrol-system/: patrol routes, checkpoints, compliance statistics
- /interactive-directory/ and /digital-directory/: kiosk and screen layers
- /white-label-wayfinding/ and /oem-odm/: white-label and integrator delivery
- /deployment-examples/: reference configurations for budgeting, no client names

## Knowledge

- /knowledge/privacy-indoor-positioning/: what data an indoor system collects and what to put in the contract

## Scope and boundaries

- Consumer navigation apps: not offered.
- Outdoor mapping, robot or drone navigation, indoor cycling: not offered.
- Asset tracking and RTLS hardware: not offered.
- Beacons and UWB are specified and integrated, not manufactured.
- Indoor GPS is an inaccurate term; the site explains why.
- Staff location is limited to dispatch, patrol and emergency mustering on consenting devices.
